name: update_entry
description: Update an existing baby log entry. Supply only fields that belong to its kind. For breastfeeding, pass the complete replacement segment list; the session's start and end are recomputed from it. To clear a diaper color, pass color 'none'.

kind.description: The entry's kind: diapers, breastfeeding, bottles, spit_ups or weights.

id.description: The entry id, as returned by list_entries.

type.description: Diapers only: poop, pee or mix.

color.description: Diapers only: meconium, transitional, mustard, yellowgreen, tan, pale, red or black. Pass 'none' to clear the color.

occurred_at.description: New time for diapers, bottles, spit-ups and weights. ISO 8601 with or without an offset, e.g. '2026-01-12T08:30:00+02:00' or '2026-01-12T08:30:00' (the latter is in the configured timezone).

volume_ml.description: Bottles only: volume in millilitres, 1 to 500.

size.description: Spit-ups only: small, medium or large.

grams.description: Weights only: weight in grams, 300 to 50000.

segments.description: Breastfeeding only: replaces all segments. Array of {side: left|right, started_at, ended_at}; each segment must end after it starts. The session's started_at and ended_at are recomputed from the segments.
